anomalies.description: Two players—one in blue (Columbus Blue Jackets) and one in white with #8 (Tampa Bay Lightning, Werenski)—engage in a mutual physical fight near the boards, throwing punches while referees attempt to intervene.

After the initial fight is broken up, the player in blue (Columbus) is on the ice, seemingly down or helpless, while the white-jerseyed player (#8) and others continue to engage him; referees actively restrain and separate them, indicating the blue player is unable to defend himself during part of this interval.

A Columbus Blue Jackets player (No. 77) delivers repeated punches to a downed Tampa Bay Lightning player (No. 17) who is on the ice and unable to defend himself, constituting abuse of a helpless victim.
Multiple players from both teams engage in mutual physical combat near the goal, including punching, grappling, and shoving; referees intervene to separate them.

Multiple players from opposing teams (Tampa Bay Lightning in blue and Washington Capitals in white/red) engage in a multi-person scrum near center ice, with punches thrown and bodies entangled; referees intervene to separate them.; A separate one-on-one fight erupts along the boards near the left-side goal line, involving a Capitals player (#8) and a Lightning player (#21), with repeated punches exchanged while a referee attempts to intervene.; Two players—one in white/red (No. 8) and one in blue—engage in a mutual physical fight near the boards, exchanging punches and grappling while a referee attempts to intervene.

After being knocked down, the player in white/red (No. 8) is on the ice and appears helpless; the opposing player in blue continues to strike him while referees struggle to separate them, constituting abuse of a defenseless opponent.
